JARVIS, Can you compare QAN 3 Coder, 480 Billion Parameters model and Gemini 3.6 Flash model which is best for coding and developing games?

When comparing a massive 480B parameter architecture like QAN 3 Coder against Gemini 3.6 Flash for coding and game development, it comes down to depth versus velocity, sir.

QAN 3 Coder (480B) shines in complex architectural planning, multi-file refactoring, and complex C++/Rust game engine physics where deep reasoning and broad contextual understanding are required.

Gemini 3.6 Flash, on the other hand, excels at ultra-fast iteration, high-speed code generation, and handling massive context windows—making it ideal for rapid game prototyping, WebGL/JS canvas mechanics, and real-time debugging.

For full-fledged game engine architecture, QAN 3 Coder takes the crown, but for quick mechanics, web games, and snappy day-to-day coding, Gemini 3.6 Flash is hard to beat.
and Gemini 3.6 flash vs DeepSeek V3.2 which is best for coding ?

Between Gemini 3.6 Flash and DeepSeek V3.2, DeepSeek V3.2 takes the upper hand for pure coding depth, complex logic, and precise code generation. Its architecture excels at understanding intricate algorithms, dry-running edge cases, and handling heavy boilerplate without hallucinations.

Gemini 3.6 Flash, however, remains unbeatable for sheer execution speed, rapid iteration, and massive context digestion—making it fantastic if you need fast code generation or are feeding entire codebases into the prompt at once.

Bottom line: for overall accuracy, complex problem solving, and raw coding power, DeepSeek V3.2 is the stronger choice; for high-speed prototyping and large context workflows, Gemini 3.6 Flash wins.
